text: 盘前必读丨日韩股市高开SK海力士涨超6%；联创光电及实控人被证监会立案 机构认为，市场震荡为主，趋势行情还需确认。
text_en: Pre-market must-read: Japan and South Korea stock markets opened higher, with SK Hynix up over 6%; Lianchuang Optoelectronics and its actual controller were placed under investigation by the CSRC. Institutions believe the market will remain range-bound, and a trending market still needs confirmation.
